/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/assas.name: ASSASSINATE THE COMMANDER
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/assas.desc: A Grineer leader will only show their face if we disrupt Grineer operations across several fronts.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/assas.name: CAPTURE THE NEW GRINEER COMMANDER
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/assas.desc: A new Grineer commander has been no end of trouble. Capture them.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.name: CAPTURE THEIR LEADER
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.desc: Deal a blow to a Grineer detachment's morale by capturing their commander.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.name: CULL THE ENEMY
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.desc: The Grineer grow too strong in number. Weaken them.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.name: WEAKEN THE GRINEER FOOTHOLD
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/attri.desc: Expel the Grineer from their outpost on the Plains

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/captu.name: CAPTURE THE GRINEER COMMANDER
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/captu.desc: A high-ranking Grineer has landed on the plains. Bring them to the Lotus.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/captu.name: SPY CATCHER
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/captu.desc: There's a Grineer spy in Cetus. Put pressure on the Grineer and force the spy out.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.name: RISE AND FALL (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.desc: Narmer are all fired up. They just promoted a cultist to Commander rank. Go and demote him to dead.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.name: FOR THE UNUM (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.desc: Narmer numbers are rising. They're planning something big. Cut them down before they march on Cetus again.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.name: BRING THEM HOME (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.desc: Narmer are recruiting by force. They've taken one of our own and are planning a veiling ceremony. Stop them.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.name: TAKING COLLECTION (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/narme.desc: Narmer are pushed to the limit. If we raid their resources, we can push them right off the Plains.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.name: FIND THE HIDDEN ARTIFACT
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.desc: The Grineer have taken an Orokin artifact. Find where they have stashed it.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.name: CAPTURE THE GRINEER AGENT
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.desc: An item of great importance to the Quills has been taken by the Grineer. Locate the agent who stole it and bring him in.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.name: RECLAIM THE STOLEN ARTIFACT
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/recla.desc: The Quills say the Grineer have stolen a precious Orokin artifact. Steal it back.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/rescu.name: SEARCH AND RESCUE
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/rescu.desc: An Ostron has gone missing on the plains. Find them and bring them home.

/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/sabot.name: PROTOTYPE SABOTAGE
/lotus/types/gameplay/eidolon/jobs/sabot.desc: Prototype tech is being delivered to the Grineer. Scour the Plains until you find it!

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: RECLAIM WHAT'S OURS
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: We are trying to regain a foothold out in Deimos. There are old bases lost to the Infestation that we need to reclaim.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: CLEANSE THE LAND
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: A powerful Infested entity has been terrorizing teams out in Deimos. Find it, and deal with it.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: FOR SCIENCE!
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: Help a stranded Corpus agent with his mission to bring Infested samples to the Entrati for science!...or Profit?

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: OVERRUN (ENDLESS)
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc:
The Infested can't be endless, can they? They must stop returning after we kill enough... right?

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: STRIP MINING (ENDLESS)
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc:
There are resources for the taking just beneath 'skin' of the Infestation covering Deimos. Dig for victory!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: ARTIFACT HUNTER (ENDLESS)
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc:
Deimos artifacts are always in demand. Bring back as many as you can!

Each stage of an Endless Bounty awards +15% Extra <MOTHER_TOKEN> Mother Tokens for every round completed.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: CORE SAMPLES
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: Search Deimos for valuable geological core samples.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: BRUTE FORCE
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: A squad of Grineer soldiers stranded on Deimos have activated their SOS beacon. Track them down and see what you can do to help.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: SALVAGE
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: Many resource caches lie abandoned and unclaimed on Deimos, find them and they are yours.

/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.name: ANOMALY RETRIEVAL
/lotus/types/gameplay/infestedmicroplane.desc: Hunt down anomalous samples in the Deimos biome.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.name: MASTER'S VOICE (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.desc: A new Narmer Raknoid overseer is in place, acting as a veil comms relay. Take it out, and we weaken their grip.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.name: CRUSH THE CULT (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.desc: Narmer are on a recruitment drive. If we don't kick back hard, they'll entrench.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.name: MINDS OF METAL (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.desc: There's a new Narmer operations drone on the field. We get that thing's datamass, we learn their next move.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.name: DIGGING FOR NARMER (NARMER)
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/narmer/.desc: Narmer cultists have staked out a mineral field so they can manufacture Veils. We need to stop them.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.name: COURIER AMBUSH
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.desc: The Taxmen uncovered an Orokin artifact. Intercept the courier and steal it.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.name: ARCHAEOLOGY
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.desc: Locate and retrieve relics from a dig site before Nef's goons can.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.name: BLOOD RELICS
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusar.desc: Offworld rail agents are jumping Nef's claim on an Orokin ruin. Save them from themselves.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusch.name: SCORCHED EARTH
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusch.desc: Draw out a notorious Corpus Overseer by targeting his assets. Then kill him.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusch.name: BURY THEM
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusch.desc: We gotta hijack some extractors. While they're prepped and launched Eudico has other work for you.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.name: NETWORK COLLAPSE
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.desc: Destroy a worker-control network, then kill its Overseer.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.name: HUNTER-KILLER
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.desc: The Corpus are running training exercises for their troops. Wreak havoc.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.name: DISTRACT AND DIVERT
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuscu.desc: Draw off Corpus security, then raid their mineral stockpile.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.name: DOG BOARDS
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.desc: The Ventkids need parts to make K-Drives. Help 'em out?

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.name: DIRT UNIT
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.desc: Blackmail a Corpus investigator. Keep him away from our people.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.name: SEEMS LEGIT
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venushe.desc: A rail agent is waiting in orbit with a tractor full of supplies. He needs a landing permit. Forge one.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.name: PROOF OF LIFE
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.desc: A team shadowing Nef's special operations unit went silent. Find them and discover what they learned.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.name: OPERATIONAL INTELLIGENCE
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.desc: Word is the Corpus are prepping for multiple operations. We need info on what those operations entail.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.name: FINANCIAL LIBERATION
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusin.desc: Locate and erase key debt ledgers before Nef's repo squads can sweep through a targeted hab.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.name: PICKET DUTY
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.desc: Patrol the Vallis. Report back on anything unusual.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.name: PROTECT THE INNOCENT
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.desc: Free Solaris citizens snatched by Nef's interrogation units.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.name: TRASH THEIR TRAPS
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuspr.desc: Cut supply to the Corpus Feed and Research Division.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venussp.name: AGENT DOWN
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venussp.desc: An SU agent is missing. Discover their fate and put a stop to Nef's plans.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusth.name: SOFTWARE SUBTERFUGE
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusth.desc: Coildrives assigned to picket duty upload data regularly. Hack one to upload a spy virus.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusth.name: RESOURCE THEFT
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venusth.desc: Taxmen excavators have ID'd a motherlode. We need those minerals. Jump that claim.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuswe.name: SERVED COLD
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuswe.desc: Hunt down and kill a notorious Corpus war criminal.

/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuswe.name: FALLING STAR
/lotus/types/gameplay/venus/jobs/venuswe.desc: Destroy the shuttle of a high-value Corpus target.
